description:
Cast Lunarch Veteran from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Lunarch Phantom.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lunarch Phantom, adding {W}.
Because Dress Down causes Lunarch Phantom to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Lunarch Veteran.
Repeat.
